studies.title: Right kidney · inside
studies.note: Capsule and outer cortical surfaces are hidden to reveal the supplied pyramids, papillae and collecting regions. Letter suffixes do not establish which papilla drains into which calyx.

studies.title: Right collecting system
studies.note: Minor and major calyx source groups with the renal pelvis. Open ends and separate inner/outer shells are retained; no continuous lumen or urine flow is simulated.

studies.title: Right kidney · supplied layers
studies.note: Start outside, then remove the capsule and outer cortex. The right renal-column source is held for geometry defects; its absence is not normal anatomy.

studies.title: Left kidney · inside
studies.note: Capsule and outer cortical surfaces are hidden to reveal the supplied pyramids, papillae and collecting regions. Letter suffixes do not establish which papilla drains into which calyx.

studies.title: Left collecting system
studies.note: Minor and major calyx source groups with the renal pelvis. Open ends and separate inner/outer shells are retained; no continuous lumen or urine flow is simulated.

studies.title: Left kidney · supplied layers
studies.note: Start outside, then remove the capsule. The left outer-cortex source is held for geometry defects; the supplied left columns are not a substitute for a complete cortex.

studies.title: Hila, pelves & vessels
studies.note: Two hila and pelves with the supplied renal arteries and right renal vein. The defective left vein is withheld. No complete vessel tree or operative hilar arrangement is established.

studies.title: Pelves & ureters
studies.note: Inspect the supplied long ureter surfaces separately from close-up renal studies. Bladder insertions, wall layers and patency are not validated.

studies.title: All supplied renal surfaces
studies.note: 82 source selections, not 82 unique anatomical concepts. Partial independent female reference; the left outer cortex, right renal columns and left renal vein remain excluded.

views.limitations: Partial independent HRA reference. Three defective surfaces are held. No renal fascia/fat, nerves, nephron microanatomy, complete vascular tree, validated drainage connections or CT/MRI registration.

studies.title: Uterus, tubes & ovaries
studies.note: Compare the supplied reproductive surfaces. Their open source boundaries are retained; the omitted uterine-end and wall alternatives are not invented or filled.

studies.title: All supplied pelvic surfaces
studies.note: 41 selected source surfaces, including optional pelvic context. This is not a complete female body or a single-patient scan.

studies.title: Uterus & cervix
studies.note: Regional uterine and cervical source surfaces. Remove a selection or set it aside; these are not validated histological wall layers or a continuous uterine lumen.

studies.title: Left adnexa
studies.note: Same-side ovary, tubal regions, supplied support and vessels with uterine context. The disputed round-ligament sources are absent. No connected lumen or full neurovascular pedicle is claimed.

studies.title: Right adnexa
studies.note: Same-side ovary, tubal regions, supplied support and vessels with uterine context. The disputed round-ligament sources are absent. No connected lumen or full neurovascular pedicle is claimed.

studies.title: Pelvic supporting surfaces
studies.note: Set the broad source surface aside to inspect available ligament and mesentery regions. Surface groups do not establish separate peritoneal layers or surgical planes.

studies.title: Uterine vessel context
studies.note: Four partial uterine vessel surfaces with uterine context. Ureters and a complete circulation are not included; no procedural crossing or flow is demonstrated.

studies.title: Bladder, uterus & rectum
studies.note: Compare native source positions. Bladder dome/base have separate source-local keys despite sharing one ontology term. Source geometry is not registered to the male body or patient imaging.

studies.title: Ureters & pelvic organs
studies.note: Existing ureters with bladder, cervix and uterine vessels in their shared HRA source frame. Ureteric-orifice candidates are excluded; no continuous lumen, validated insertion or surgical crossing is claimed.

studies.title: Left ureter & pelvic context
studies.note: Same-source ureter with ipsilateral uterine vessels and bladder/cervix context. These partial surfaces do not establish operative tissue planes, patency or a registered scan.

studies.title: Right ureter & pelvic context
studies.note: Same-source ureter with ipsilateral uterine vessels and bladder/cervix context. These partial surfaces do not establish operative tissue planes, patency or a registered scan.

views.limitations: Partial separate HRA reference. Six disputed/overlapping sources are withheld; no complete female skeleton, pelvic floor, nerves, pregnancy model or scan registration.

dedicatedShoulder.changes: Subset selection; rigid common coordinate transform; vertex welding and normal recomputation; OBJ to GLB. Appearance modified at runtime. No per-part registration or reshaping.

limitations: Counts are separate units and must not be added to root or nested selections as unique anatomy.
A frame-qualified selection ID is a source identity, not a clinically unique structure.
Declared bundle hashes are verified metadata bindings; this generator does not read model payloads.
Display transforms are not cross-donor or patient-space registration.
Rights metadata and engineering inclusion are not clinical, privacy or release approval.
Expected curriculum and excluded or held originals need separate source-specific adjudication.
